The '''Gyrda keypad''' was a small handheld device similar in appearance to a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]<ref name="TPM VD" /> or a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with a built-in viewscreen.<ref name="TPM CD">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> These devices were used to unlock doors, and the keypad's display confirmed transmission of door entry code upon entry.<ref name="TPM VD" />
